lang.name: English
update.installing: Installing the update… the app reopens by itself.
onb.title: Let's get everything ready
onb.s1.title: Find Deadlock
onb.s1.no_steam: Couldn't find Steam. Choose the Deadlock folder manually.
onb.s1.no_game: Couldn't find Deadlock in your Steam libraries. Choose the folder manually.
onb.s1.no_account: Couldn't find your account. Open Steam while logged in, or enter your Steam account number in Settings.
onb.s2.title: Turn on the game log
onb.s2.intro: This is how the app knows a match is starting. Nothing is injected into the game.
onb.s3.title: Open Deadlock
onb.s3.body: Open Deadlock from Steam (if it was already running, close it and open it again). This step completes by itself when the game opens.
guide.title: How it works
guide.1.title: Join a match
guide.1.sub: Casual or ranked, on the standard map. Keep this window open.
guide.2.title: Wait 1 to 2 minutes
guide.2.sub: The app reads the heroes in the match and builds against your lane.
guide.3.title: Copy it and paste it in the game
guide.3.sub: Shop → Browse builds → Create build → Paste build.
now.lanes_open: Lanes can still be swapped. The button unlocks when they lock.
now.copied: Copied “{name}”. Now paste it in the game. Suggested swaps compare against this build.
now.copied_short: Copied! Now paste it in the game: Shop → Browse builds → Create build → Paste build.
now.lane_unknown: lane unknown — the lane build uses general stats
swaps.title: Swap to counter
lane.title: Lane build
lane.read: Buy from left to right. Dashed items turn into the next item.
full.title: After the lane
item.stats_title: Bought on average at {min} min · {n} matches · popularity {pop}%
item.component_title: Component: buy it first, to upgrade it later
ab.title: Ability order
ab.meta: the order players of this hero use
ab.meta_n: the order players of this hero use · {n} matches followed this path
enemies.title: Opponents
enemies.sub: win rate against each one · items that help the most
enemies.none: no item with a clear edge
set.game_dir.help: Leave empty to detect it automatically. In Steam: Deadlock → Properties → Installed Files → Browse.
set.account.help: Leave empty to use the account logged into Steam.
set.rank: Rank of the matches used for the stats
set.rank.help: Higher ranks = data from better players, but fewer matches.
set.overlay: Show overlay on top of the game
set.auto_update: Update automatically (installs new versions outside of matches)
set.apikey.ph: without a key you can follow about 6 matches per hour
set.apikey.help: Only needed if you play many matches in a row.
set.saved_restart: Saved. Some changes only apply after a restart.
man.summary: Manual mode (no match / if detection fails)
man.hint: Click to mark enemies. Click again to mark them as a lane enemy. A third click removes the mark.
fb.title: Feedback & help
fb.body: Found a bug, have an idea, or something looks wrong? Tell me — it really helps.
fb.diag_copied: Copied. Paste it in your report.
fb.diag_hint: No personal data: only the app version, language and status.
sup.title: Support the project
sup.body: This app is free, has no ads, and nothing is locked. If it helped you win, you can chip in to keep it updated.
foot.data: Data: deadlock-api.com (recent matches). Win rates are smoothed; “(+x)” is how much better the item does than its average for your hero.
foot.not_affiliated: Fan-made tool, not affiliated with Valve. It never touches the game: it only reads its log file.
msg.no_game_dir: Couldn't find Deadlock in your Steam libraries. Choose its folder in Settings.
msg.no_condebug: The game log is not turned on. Add -condebug to Deadlock's launch options in Steam, then reopen the game.
msg.no_log: The game log doesn't exist yet. Add -condebug to Deadlock's launch options in Steam and open the game.
msg.match_found: Match {id} found. Reading the enemy heroes…
msg.no_account: Couldn't find your Steam account. Enter it in Settings.
msg.street_brawl: Street Brawl: items are drafted, not bought. There is no build to recommend.
msg.error: Something went wrong reading this match. Use manual mode on the page.
msg.manual_error: Something went wrong calculating the build.
msg.match_ended: Match over. Waiting for the next one…
msg.lane_updated: Lane updated: now against {names}. Lane build recalculated.
msg.copy_blocked: Waiting for the lanes to lock: the lane build can still change.
live.not_ready: Waiting for Valve's broadcast to be ready (usually 1 to 2 minutes)…
live.connecting: Connecting to the live match broadcast…
live.account_missing: Your account was not found in this match. Check your Steam account in Settings.
live.cant_read: Couldn't read the players of this match.
live.no_players: The broadcast has no players yet.
upd.manual: Version {ver} is available. Download it from the project page.
upd.ready_auto: Version {ver} downloaded. It installs by itself when you're not in a match.
upd.manual_only: Please download the new version from the project page.
upd.installing: Installing the update… the app reopens by itself.
upd.unverified: The new version couldn't be verified, so it was not installed.
upd.corrupt: The download is damaged and was discarded.
err.restart_unavailable: automatic restart is unavailable; close and reopen the app
err.not_game_dir: doesn't look like the Deadlock folder
pnl.page: Page: {url}  ·  close this window to quit
